change_set.name: create_finance_tables
change_set.summary: Adds accounts, people, categories and transactions so payments can be recorded and grouped.

changes.description: Places where money is kept, such as a bank account or a wallet.

columns.name: name
columns.description: What the account is called.

columns.name: opening_balance
columns.description: Money in the account when tracking started.

changes.description: People whose spending is tracked, such as family members.

columns.name: name
columns.description: The person's name.

changes.description: Groups for spending and income, such as groceries or salary.

columns.name: name
columns.description: What the category is called.

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: The account the money moved in or out of.

columns.name: person_id
columns.description: The person this payment belongs to, if any.

columns.name: category_id
columns.description: The group this payment falls under.

columns.name: occurred_on
columns.description: The day the payment happened.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: How much was paid. Negative for money spent.

columns.name: note
columns.description: Anything worth remembering about this payment.

findings.message: Column account_id in transactions points at account, which does not exist. Did you mean accounts?
